data.one_liner: Download internet files and optionally cache them locally across all platforms.
data.what_it_does: InternetFile provides a simple API to fetch files from the web and return them as Uint8List. It can also store the file locally using a pluggable storage implementation, supporting progress callbacks and custom headers.
use_when: Fetching assets like fonts, PDFs or images that need to be cached locally
Integrating with plugins that require direct file access on any platform
Implementing custom storage logic for web or offline support
avoid_when: You only need a single HTTP request without caching or progress tracking
You prefer a full-featured HTTP client like Dio for complex request handling
strengths: Optional local storage with pluggable implementation
Progress callback with received and total bytes
Simple API, no code generation required
weaknesses: No advanced caching policies (e.g., TTL, eviction)
Relies on http and universal_file, so adding it increases dependencies
Limited to file download, not general HTTP requests

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use http for simple single-file downloads without the need for local caching or progress callbacks.
